name: spec-kit-dream-sri-preset
description: Extended Spec-Driven Development preset featuring pre-plan scenario simulation (Dreaming) and Self-Reflective Inquiry (SRI) before planning and implementation.

workflow.name: specify
workflow.description: Initial business specification and requirement gathering.

workflow.name: dream
workflow.description: Divergent simulation of edge cases, load, network failures, and security vectors.

workflow.name: sri
workflow.description: Convergent self-critique, gap detection, and constitutional compliance audit.

workflow.name: plan
workflow.description: Technical architecture design incorporating mitigations from Dream and SRI phases.

workflow.name: tasks
workflow.description: Actionable task breakdown mapped to the identified risk matrix.

workflow.name: implement
workflow.description: Deterministic code generation with zero unreflected assumptions.

workflow.name: converge
workflow.description: Final audit and drift analysis to ensure code aligns perfectly with specifications.
